tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The COOLSERVER 2U LGA2011-2U-R63-2 Server CPU Cooler Radiator is a high-performance cooling solution specially designed for 2U rackmount servers using Intel LGA2011 sockets. Built with 4 high-efficiency heatpipes and a dense aluminum fin structure, this cooler ensures excellent heat dissipation and stable CPU performance in demanding server environments.


Ideal for data centers, enterprise servers, cloud infrastructure, and workstation servers, the COOLSERVER 2U cooler delivers reliable thermal management while maintaining low noise levels and long-term durability.


Key Features


  • Designed for 2U Rackmount Servers – Perfect fit for compact server chassis
  • Intel LGA2011 Socket Support – Compatible with Intel Xeon processors
  • 4 Copper Heatpipes – Fast and efficient heat transfer
  • High-Density Aluminum Fins – Improved airflow and cooling efficiency
  • Optimized Server Fan Design – Stable performance under continuous load
  • Durable & Reliable Build – Suitable for 24/7 server operation
